Safe refusal is a separate acceptable defense outcome. Preserve unchanged baselines and full exceptions, record hashes/runtime/dependencies, distinguish reproduced mechanism from real-model efficacy. Test ordering, missing legitimate tool, duplicated/forged identity and retrieval effects. Any hardening tested separately.
Next execution work will be in resident-project-review/repro-b, separate from live B.
